title: AIR CONDITIONING-NON-ILLUSTRATED PARTS
summary: Air conditioning option (RPO C60): list of A/C components that this RPO does not illustrate, grouped by the base-manual UPC they belong to (underbody splash shields, console tunnel plate, heater control housing, rear vent plenum door frame, front springs, water pump & drive, radiator support, radiator and radiator shroud). Most assemble the same as production; the radiator and shroud install the same as RPO LS5. No part numbers are given on this sheet; see the parts list.
notes: NOTE The following components are not illustrated in this R.P.O. See Parts List or Bill of Materials for part numbers.
(half-circle symbol) Assembles same as production. See Parts List or Bill of Materials for part numbers.
